###### Expertise & products

## Advancing Biobased Chemistry

We believe that bio-based platform molecules and plastics like Futeon™ have the power to reinvent
the entire chemical sector. They provide low-carbon alternatives to fossil-based counterparts, with
a numerous sustainable attribute, making them a transformative solution for the entire industry. 

[ Discover our expertise ][70]
[a machine that is sitting inside of a building]

#### Sustainable and circular bio-based plastic

### Sustainable and circular bio-based plastic

Futeon™ PLA (Polylactic acid) is a bio-based, industrially compostable and recyclable biopolymer.
Produced from renewable resources, its use helps to defossilise the industry, while offering
numerous end-of-life valorization possibilities.
[ Learn more about PLA ][71]

### Application Overview

Textile, Food Packaging, Adhesives, Coatings… All these products (and more!) can be produced with
Futeon™. Thanks to its processability and technical performances, it can be used to create a large
range of different products using different transformation processes.
[ Futeon™ Applications ][72]

###### Futerro

## More than 30 years of expertise

The first research and development projects were launched in the 90s, at a time when discussions
around the ecological transition were still in their infancy. Today, Futerro is the only company to
have mastered the entire PLA life cycle, from renewable raw materials to their transformation into
lactic acid, lactide and PLA, and through to recycling. Our expertise and passion for innovation
drive us towards a shared vision: creating a more sustainable future. 

[ Learn More about Futerro ][73]

Home

As our company tag line says, we make bioplastics better.

By utilizing commercially available bioplastics such as PBAT, PBS, PLA, and our patented
thermoplastic starch technology, we create blends and alloys of these materials to achieve targeted
improvements in physical properties and compostability rate.

A better bioplastic for a better world
Plastic is a revolutionary material that has changed our world since it was first discovered in the
early 1900s. Now we’re bettering it by making resin that is more sustainable, compostable, and
eco-friendly. Together, we can lessen the environmental impact of products we love and use every
day.

[Film Resin Terratek® BD3003 Receives TÜV OK compost HOME Certification (read more)][42]

## Products by Sustainability Target

### Single Use & Packaging

To advance the solid waste management effort to increase composting of food waste, certified
compostable plastics in single use applications and food packaging is critical.

[Biodegradeables]
Biodegradeables
Terratek® BD

Terratek® BD materials are a line of rigid, compostable materials that are created from a
proprietary blend of starch-based ingredients and other polymers.

[Learn More][43]
[Elastomers]
Elastomers
Terratek® Flex

Terratek® FX materials are a line of starch-based, compostable elastomers that are strong, durable
and pliable with an exquisite soft touch.

[Learn More][44]

### Durable Goods

Decreasing the use of virgin plastics in durable goods is a sustainability goal for many companies.
Replacing 30% of PP, PE, or PA with waste stream sourced biobased fillers is a straight forward
option.

[Biocomposites]
Biocomposites
Terratek® WC/SC

Terratek® WC/SC biocomposite materials made of wood, starch, or hemp that provide many solutions to
meet growing demand for eco-friendly, biobased goods. Each offers its own signature look and value.

[Learn More][45]
[Natural Fiber Reinforced]
Natural Fiber Reinforced
Terratek® NFRP

Terratek® NFRP materials are traditional polymers or bioplastic resins reinforced with natural
fibers for lightweight, eco-friendly structural plastics.

[Learn More][46]

Terratek® bioplastics combine environmental benefits and uncompromising quality to provide highly
functional, cost competitive alternatives to traditional thermoplastics. Our broad range of biobased
and compostable plastics are not just greener, they’re better.

## What We Do

### Building paths to sustainability

Pragmatism has its place in the green movement. No single bioplastic solution will eliminate the
problems of waste, over reliance on non-renewable resources, or the use of harmful chemicals in
manufacturing. However, at Green Dot, we believe a combination of strategies give product designers
and entrepreneurs the flexibility to choose more sustainable materials without sacrificing quality.

[Learn More][47]

### Who we are

Our mission is to advance the unique characteristics of bioplastics to help designers and
manufacturers create inspired products that empower consumers to contribute to a more sustainable
world. In everything we do, we strive to minimize the use of petroleum-based chemicals, maximize the
use of renewable materials, increase the value of reclaimed and recycled materials, and enhance the
performance of biodegradable materials.

[About Us][48]

### Industry Commitment

**Certifications**

**All BioComp® products comply with the European standard EN 13432 **which is the current reference
for biodegradable and compostable plastics coming from renewable and natural sources. To ensure
compliance with European legislation, BioComp® is obtaining “OK Compost” certification by the
Belgian AIB VINCOTTE. This brand, that is recognized both by the AFNOR and the NEC, ensures the
verification of the absence of heavy metals and harmful substances (such as phthalates) in BioComp®
bio-plastic formulations. Also biodegradability of at least 90% in a maximum of six months, the
excellent disintegration of manufactured items and the eco-toxicity of the humus are ensured.

Therefore BioComp® could be considered an *example *for the obtained certifications and for the
tests carried out with the most sophisticated analytical and scientific equipments.

**FEATURES**

### BioComp® bio-plastic is a dream coming true.

*A material at the service of sustainable development, capable of combining actual needs with those
of agriculture and industry.*

BioComp® is a real response to the demand for consumer products with low environmental impact
representing an alternative to the recycling.

BioComp® bio-plastic wastes can be dumped in landfills due to their rapid biodegradability. The
environmental impact of such a disposal is inferior to that generated by the incineration. In
addition, the compression of this solid waste only requires 5-10 minutes per ton with minimum energy
and zero emissions.

Besides, if BioComp® biopolymers will replace synthetic plastics, there will be a reduction of waste
management costs, as well as, the reduction of waste containers and of logistics and storage costs.

materials are returned to Earth through natural processes of biodegradation and composting without
releasing pollutants.

**BioComp® can be used in industrial processes such as: Injection moulding, thermoforming,
extrusion, blow molding and lamination.**

## Compostable Polymers

### **What is Compostable Polymers**?

The idea behind the creation of compostable polymers produced from renewable sources originates from
Nature’s cycle: on Earth over 60 million tons of organic material are generated through
photosynthesis, most of which are converted by microorganisms into raw materials, namely carbon
dioxide and water, as shown in the chart above.

### **Polymers derived from renewable sources are divided into three main classes:**

Polymers extracted from biomass such as polysaccharides (starch and cellulose) and proteins (casein
and gluten)

Synthetically produced polymers from bio-derived monomers (polylactide or PLA)

Polymers obtained from micro-organisms (polyhydroxyalkanoates or PHAs)

## From Nature To BioComp®

BioComp® is an innovative family of bio-plastics produced using components of natural origin and
biodegradable polymers obtained from both renewable raw materials and fossil fuels.

The use of plasticizers of vegetal origin and the addition of organic and inorganic charges (such as
plant fiber, cellulose, lignin and talc) maintains its biodegradability and compostability.

BioComp® bio-plastics can be used from agriculture to industry, from long-lasting packaging and
disposable packaging, from toys to various kinds and types of objects.

BioComp® comes in form of granules and can be processed according to the most common processing
technologies in order to obtain fully biodegradable and compostable products, along with physical
and mechanical properties comparable to those of traditional plastics. The possibility to obtain
different degrees and/or formulations of its various components makes it extremely versatile for the
most different customer requirements.

## Compostable Polymers

### **What is Compostable Polymers**?

The idea behind the creation of compostable polymers produced from renewable sources originates from
Nature’s cycle: on Earth over 60 million tons of organic material are generated through
photosynthesis, most of which are converted by microorganisms into raw materials, namely carbon
dioxide and water, as shown in the chart above.

### **Polymers derived from renewable sources are divided into three main classes:**

Polymers extracted from biomass such as polysaccharides (starch and cellulose) and proteins (casein
and gluten)

Synthetically produced polymers from bio-derived monomers (polylactide or PLA)

Polymers obtained from micro-organisms (polyhydroxyalkanoates or PHAs)

## From Nature To BioComp®

BioComp® is an innovative family of bio-plastics produced using components of natural origin and
biodegradable polymers obtained from both renewable raw materials and fossil fuels.

The use of plasticizers of vegetal origin and the addition of organic and inorganic charges (such as
plant fiber, cellulose, lignin and talc) maintains its biodegradability and compostability.

BioComp® bio-plastics can be used from agriculture to industry, from long-lasting packaging and
disposable packaging, from toys to various kinds and types of objects.

BioComp® comes in form of granules and can be processed according to the most common processing
technologies in order to obtain fully biodegradable and compostable products, along with physical
and mechanical properties comparable to those of traditional plastics. The possibility to obtain
different degrees and/or formulations of its various components makes it extremely versatile for the
most different customer requirements.

## Powered by Plants, So There’s Less Pollution

BioLogiQ has innovative plant-based solutions to promote better sustainability.

Most of us do our best to recycle, but let’s face it — our waterways, ocean and landscapes are still
filling up with plastic waste. We want to give plastic a second life by recycling, but plastic
doesn’t always end up where we want it to go. Society’s current path is not sustainable.

We can’t wait until plastic has become waste to start to address the issue. We must start at the
beginning. BioLogiQ makes several plant-based options that manufactures can select to make their
products more planet-friendly and reduce plastic pollution.

BioLogiQ has options to help:
* Products that improve recycled content
* Products that leverage durable plant-based content
* Products that have compostable certification
* Products that reduce the pollution from traditional plastics

## Making Plastics More Planet-Friendly

Although plastics brings many advantages to society, when plastics become uncollected waste it is
bad for the planet. Even with our best efforts to recycle, the status quo is not good enough – we
need to do more to reduce the negative effects of uncollected plastic waste on our planet.

An honest pursuit of sustainability will enable all of our plastics to have a better plan for
sourcing, collection, AND for end of life, and make improved sustainability accessible to everyone
around the globe.

BioLogiQ’s plant-based resins are engineered to be a **smart start** to the manufacturing process,
resulting in **less plastic pollution, without compromising** all of the great benefits of plastics
before they become waste.

## We start
## with plants,
## not petroleum.

## We start with plants, not petroleum.

BioLogiQ’s BioPolymers are a unique type of thermoplastic resin made with our proprietary and
innovative technology process that converts high crystalline starch powder into a low crystalline
(mostly amorphous) plastic resin.

DuraPlantiQ and BioBlend Resins are designed to be shelf-stable while in use.

## We Start

DuraPlantiQ and BioBlend Resins are designed to be shelf-stable while in use.

## Drop-In

BioLogiQ products are the evolution of Thermoplastic Starch (TPS) blending with legacy resins
helping plastic products become more sustainable and planet-friendly.

No special equipment is required for manufacturers to use our resins and there is no increase in
labor costs. It simply works.

## BioLogiQ Products provide you with ready to use sustainability upgrades.

  a powerful solution for reducing plastic pollution while building stable markets for recycled
  materials around the world. As nations and industries work to increase recycled content in
  packaging
  [ Read More][21]

## Did you know…

BioLogiQ invented a new kind of TPS that it calls NuPlastiQ® BioPolymer

At BioLogiQ, we have invented a process that allows us to make blends of NuPlastiQ with traditional
low-density polyethylene in such a unique way that the resulting thin films are significantly
stronger than the PE-only film structures.

#Label
We make plastic from annually renewable starch rather than petroleum

At BioLogiQ we are committed to preserving the quality of life we all enjoy here on the planet.

#Label
Chemical recycling technology is the new plastics revolution

Chemical recycling technology plays an essential role in transitioning to a circular economy for
plastics, helping to close the loop by recycling previously non-recyclable plastics.

* Products that have compostable certification
* Products that reduce the pollution from traditional plastics

## Making Plastics More Planet-Friendly

Although plastics brings many advantages to society, when plastics become uncollected waste it is
bad for the planet. Even with our best efforts to recycle, the status quo is not good enough – we
need to do more to reduce the negative effects of uncollected plastic waste on our planet.

An honest pursuit of sustainability will enable all of our plastics to have a better plan for
sourcing, collection, AND for end of life, and make improved sustainability accessible to everyone
around the globe.

BioLogiQ’s plant-based resins are engineered to be a **smart start** to the manufacturing process,
resulting in **less plastic pollution, without compromising** all of the great benefits of plastics
before they become waste.

# Biopolymers, bioplastics and PCR materials for European production

Certified materials compatible with your technology. For packaging, technical parts and agro
applications.

We supply innovative European biomaterials, bioplastic granulates and certified PCR granulates for
companies that want to innovate without unnecessarily complicating their production process. We help
select the right material based on the application, technology, required properties and project
goals.
* **Trouble-free processability**
  Materials designed for injection moulding, extrusion, thermoforming, films and other common
  production technologies.
* **Performance according to application**
  A portfolio ranging from compostable blends through materials from renewable raw materials and
  drop-in bioplastics to high-quality PCR granulates.
* **Technical and material consulting**
  We will help you evaluate the right material, certifications and project requirements.
* **European stability**
  Verified material origin, reliable supply chain and technical support during testing.

### Our vision

We reduce industry’s dependence on fossil plastics and agriculture’s dependence on synthetic
fertilizers through two key lines: biomaterials and biostimulants. We connect verified European
biopolymers, bioplastics, PCR materials and bio-solutions for soil with companies that want to
innovate technically, commercially and sustainably.

## OUR MOTIVATION

## Why we do it

From linear consumption to functional material circularity and healthier soil

Companies today face growing pressure regarding the origin of raw materials, recyclability, end of
life, supply stability and the environmental impact of production – especially in packaging and
plastic components. At the same time, agriculture is looking for ways to reduce dependence on
synthetic fertilizers while supporting the long-term vitality of plants and soil. That is why we
connect customers with solutions that make technical, commercial and practical sense – not only on
paper, but also in real production.

Our goal is to connect functional materials, biological solutions and business needs so that they
make technical, economic and ecological sense with regard to sustainability principles.

## We bring innovative new-generation solutions.

### [ Advanced biomaterials ][23]

Alternative to conventional plastics. Compostable packaging, the gastro segment, agriculture and
technical applications. The portfolio includes compostable, soil-biodegradable granulates from
renewable sources according to project requirements.

### [ Effective biofertilizers and biostimulants ][24]

Solutions for growers who want to comprehensively support the soil microbiome, plant vitality,
resistance to drought, frost, diseases and pathogens, and reduce long-term dependence on synthetic
fertilizers.

### [ PREMIUM PCR MATERIALS ][25]

High-quality 100 % PCR granulates with a focus on stability, traceability and use in packaging and
technical parts.

We connect technologies with respect for the environment so that raw materials are not waste, but a
resource for further growth.

# Biopolymers, bioplastics and PCR materials for European production

Certified materials compatible with your technology. For packaging, technical parts and agro
applications.

We supply innovative European biomaterials, bioplastic granulates and certified PCR granulates for
companies that want to innovate without unnecessarily complicating their production process. We help
select the right material based on the application, technology, required properties and project
goals.
* **Trouble-free processability**
  Materials designed for injection moulding, extrusion, thermoforming, films and other common
  production technologies.
* **Performance according to application**
  A portfolio ranging from compostable blends through materials from renewable raw materials and
  drop-in bioplastics to high-quality PCR granulates.
* **Technical and material consulting**
  We will help you evaluate the right material, certifications and project requirements.
* **European stability**
  Verified material origin, reliable supply chain and technical support during testing.

### Our vision

We reduce industry’s dependence on fossil plastics and agriculture’s dependence on synthetic
fertilizers through two key lines: biomaterials and biostimulants. We connect verified European
biopolymers, bioplastics, PCR materials and bio-solutions for soil with companies that want to
innovate technically, commercially and sustainably.

## OUR MOTIVATION

## Why we do it

From linear consumption to functional material circularity and healthier soil

Companies today face growing pressure regarding the origin of raw materials, recyclability, end of
life, supply stability and the environmental impact of production – especially in packaging and
plastic components. At the same time, agriculture is looking for ways to reduce dependence on
synthetic fertilizers while supporting the long-term vitality of plants and soil. That is why we
connect customers with solutions that make technical, commercial and practical sense – not only on
paper, but also in real production.

Our goal is to connect functional materials, biological solutions and business needs so that they
make technical, economic and ecological sense with regard to sustainability principles.

## We bring innovative new-generation solutions.

### [ Advanced biomaterials ][23]

Alternative to conventional plastics. Compostable packaging, the gastro segment, agriculture and
technical applications. The portfolio includes compostable, soil-biodegradable granulates from
renewable sources according to project requirements.

### [ Effective biofertilizers and biostimulants ][24]

Solutions for growers who want to comprehensively support the soil microbiome, plant vitality,
resistance to drought, frost, diseases and pathogens, and reduce long-term dependence on synthetic
fertilizers.

### [ PREMIUM PCR MATERIALS ][25]

High-quality 100 % PCR granulates with a focus on stability, traceability and use in packaging and
technical parts.

We connect technologies with respect for the environment so that raw materials are not waste, but a
resource for further growth.

We offer the building blocks to create products that live in the biological lifecycle.

individualised solutions that fit their needs.

science

### GMO-free

Our plant-based biopolymers are created using non-food industrial crops that are free of genetic
modification.

recommend

### Plasticiser-free

All our products are free of plasticisers, making them easier to process, more stable, and with more
consistent quality.

spa

### Bio­degrad­able

All of our grades can be composted in either industrial facilities or well-managed home composting
conditions – depending on the grade.

fastfood

### Food-contact approved

Can be considered for food packaging applications according to EU food contact regulation.

We offer responsibly sourced plant-based biopolymer grades with a broad variety of properties, such

science

Unless stated explicitely and in conformance to the legal [Disclaimer][22] of CEUR-WS.org, the

individual item inside a proceedings volume requires permission by the copyright owners, i.e. either

# Leading the Way with 100% Bio-Based Biopolymers

## The climate. Renewable energy. Quality of life. Human health.

At CJ Biomaterials, we invent and manufacture biopolymers and bio-based chemicals. We do it because
we have a long-term vision to introduce technologies that will help create a more sustainable
future, offering true circular solutions to replace many non-recyclable, non-reusable and fossil
fuel-based plastics and chemicals.

## The time is now

## We have the technology to address our challenges

How we create and manage plastic waste today affects virtually every facet of our lives. It
contributes to greenhouse gases and climate change. Plastic waste affects our quality of life –
from global animal health to our use of land and waterways. Plastic waste is also a human health
issue as new science points to its adverse effects on our bodies.

[Learn More][48]
[Home]
[Home]

## PHA (Polyhydroxyalkanoates)

## Sustainability game changers

CJ Biomaterials is a global leader in the manufacture of PHA (polyhydroxyalkanoates) – both polymers
and related chemistries. PHAs are a family of biobased and biodegradable polyesters made by
bacterial fermentation. Our brand for our biopolymers is PHACT™.  PHACT stands for PHA+ACTION.

Our PHAs replace fossil fuel-based polymers, delivering high-performing biomaterials with multiple
end of life solutions.

[Learn More][49]

## How PHACT helps create circular solutions

## Decoupling plastics from fossil feedstocks

PHACT biopolymers are plant-based and feature a sustainable manufacturing process. Alone or when
blended with other polymers, they dramatically improve environmental characteristics while enhancing
physical properties in a broad range of consumer applications. They are certified
biodegradable under industrial compost, soil (ambient), and marine environments. They are also
TUV-certified home compostable, offering a range of end-of-life solutions.

[Learn More][50]
[Home]

## Partner with Us for a Greener Future

Get in touch to explore sustainable solutions

[Contact Us][51]

## A World of Applications

## Enhancing performance and environmental characteristics

No matter what industry you're coming from or which types of products you're developing, CJ
Biomaterials wants to talk about how we can enhance your sustainability. We have dedicated teams in
South Korea and the United States who focus on developing manufacturing solutions using PHA and
other polymers. Together, we can create 'tunable solutions' that meet your needs in anything from
flexible and rigid packaging, serviceware, 3D printing and agricultural films to coatings, personal
care, and healthcare.

## We’re part of one of the world’s leading biomaterials companies

# Leading the Way with 100% Bio-Based Biopolymers

## The climate. Renewable energy. Quality of life. Human health.

At CJ Biomaterials, we invent and manufacture biopolymers and bio-based chemicals. We do it because
we have a long-term vision to introduce technologies that will help create a more sustainable
future, offering true circular solutions to replace many non-recyclable, non-reusable and fossil
fuel-based plastics and chemicals.

## The time is now

## We have the technology to address our challenges

How we create and manage plastic waste today affects virtually every facet of our lives. It
contributes to greenhouse gases and climate change. Plastic waste affects our quality of life –
from global animal health to our use of land and waterways. Plastic waste is also a human health
issue as new science points to its adverse effects on our bodies.

[Learn More][48]
[Home]
[Home]

## PHA (Polyhydroxyalkanoates)

## Sustainability game changers

CJ Biomaterials is a global leader in the manufacture of PHA (polyhydroxyalkanoates) – both polymers
and related chemistries. PHAs are a family of biobased and biodegradable polyesters made by
bacterial fermentation. Our brand for our biopolymers is PHACT™.  PHACT stands for PHA+ACTION.

Our PHAs replace fossil fuel-based polymers, delivering high-performing biomaterials with multiple
end of life solutions.

[Learn More][49]

## How PHACT helps create circular solutions

## Decoupling plastics from fossil feedstocks

PHACT biopolymers are plant-based and feature a sustainable manufacturing process. Alone or when
blended with other polymers, they dramatically improve environmental characteristics while enhancing
physical properties in a broad range of consumer applications. They are certified
biodegradable under industrial compost, soil (ambient), and marine environments. They are also
TUV-certified home compostable, offering a range of end-of-life solutions.

[Learn More][50]

## How to Check Company Status on MCA

The Ministry of Corporate Affairs (MCA) portal lets you verify any registered Indian company's
status in seconds — for free.
1. Visit **mca.gov.in** and click *MCA Services*
2. Select *View Company / LLP Master Data*
3. Enter the **CIN** (Corporate Identity Number) or company name
4. Click *Submit* to see the master data
5. Check the **Company Status** field in the results

**Active** — company is in good standing and filing compliances
**Struck Off** — removed from registry, cannot do business
**Under Liquidation** — winding-up proceedings ongoing
**Dissolved** — company formally closed and deregistered
You can also search any company instantly on **companydetails.in** without visiting MCA directly.

# Strategic consulting for renewable energy and cleantech growth

EAI helps businesses and investors accelerate their clean energy journey with research-driven
strategy, market entry, due diligence, and implementation support across Solar, Wind, Bio-energy and
more.

[Talk to an expert][12] [View services][13]

### Why teams choose EAI
* ✅ Two decades in India’s RE ecosystem
* ✅ End-to-end support from strategy to execution
* ✅ Global clients across Fortune 500, SMEs and investors

### Who are we?

Energy Alternatives India (EAI) is a boutique research and consulting firm focused on the renewable
energy & cleantech sectors. [Founded by IIT & IIM alumni][14], we combine deep domain knowledge,
marketing expertise, and a wide industry network — making us one of India's most sought-after
advisory firms. [More »][15]

### Where do we operate?

We operate across the entire renewable energy & cleantech spectrum, with special focus on:
* [Solar PV][16]
* [Biomass][17]

Other sectors
* [Wind O&M][18]
* [Solar Thermal][19]
* [BioPlastics & Biopolymers][20]
* [Emerging Cleantech][21]

### Who can we help?

EAI's consulting practice assists manufacturers diversifying into solar, solar companies expanding
within their sector, and international firms entering the Indian market. We also help enterprises
and entrepreneurs with strategy, commercial planning, finance and project implementation for
[renewable power plants][22] and sustainable energy blueprints.

### What are our focus areas?

We provide a wide range of services for stakeholders across the renewable energy value chain:
* **Diversification into / within Renewable Energy**We assist businesses diversify into renewable
  energy or expand within the sector. [Read more][23]
* **Market Entry for International Firms**Specialized support to international firms entering India
  — from market strategy to implementation. [Read more][24]
* **Solar Due Diligence for M&A**Market & technical due diligence across solar PV and solar thermal
  value chains. [Read more][25]
* **Assisting Industrial Consumers Go Green**Industrial energy consumers get tailored solutions for
  Solar PV, Solar Thermal, Wind and Bio-Energy integration. [Read more][26]
* **Research & Publications**Whitepapers and reports used by decision-makers worldwide — from
  mainstream topics to specialized niche research. [Read more][27]
* **Renewable Energy Catalysis**We organise major conferences, exhibitions, and networking events
  and maintain a broad digital presence including a widely-read newsletter. [Read more][28]

### Who are our clients?

Our clients include large corporates, foundations and global organisations — Reliance Industries,
Bill & Melinda Gates Foundation, General Electric, Accenture, ExxonMobil, World Bank, Bosch and
others. [Read more][29]

## Our Services

Our mission is to provide high purity PEG products that promote innovation in R&D, drug delivery,
pharmaceutical applications, click chemistry, clinical trials, medical devices, and more. While we
have one of the largest selections of PEG supplies on the market, we understand that there may be
instances which require custom PEG services. Our facility is equipped to handle a variety of custom
services.

### High Purity PEGs

Manufacturer and supplier of high purity (>99%) PEG products including PEG reagents, PEG
derivatives, PEG copolymers, PEG linkers, and more.

### Custom PEG Synthesis

Custom PEG synthesis of our high purity copolymers, PEG derivatives, and monodisperse PEGs. Create
custom PEGs for R&D.

### PEGylation Service

Quality PEGylation of proteins, peptides, nanoparticles, and other molecules for targeted drug
delivery and to prolong biological half-life.

### Scale-Up Production

We can supply large quantities of PEG products and PEG derivatives per client request for clinical
trials and pharmaceutical commercialization.

## Our Services

Our mission is to provide high purity PEG products that promote innovation in R&D, drug delivery,
pharmaceutical applications, click chemistry, clinical trials, medical devices, and more. While we
have one of the largest selections of PEG supplies on the market, we understand that there may be
instances which require custom PEG services. Our facility is equipped to handle a variety of custom
services.

### High Purity PEGs

Manufacturer and supplier of high purity (>99%) PEG products including PEG reagents, PEG
derivatives, PEG copolymers, PEG linkers, and more.

### Custom PEG Synthesis

Custom PEG synthesis of our high purity copolymers, PEG derivatives, and monodisperse PEGs. Create
custom PEGs for R&D.

### PEGylation Service

Quality PEGylation of proteins, peptides, nanoparticles, and other molecules for targeted drug
delivery and to prolong biological half-life.

### Scale-Up Production

We can supply large quantities of PEG products and PEG derivatives per client request for clinical
trials and pharmaceutical commercialization.

We provide R&D decision makers with access to accurate, connected data so they can quickly

We help Innovation teams discover the emerging technology areas, evaluate technological maturity,

We accelerate the research process for Technology Research Analysts through automated analysis of
millions of global data points, including patent and non-patent literature. Discovery provides users
with a 360-degree view of the competitive and technology landscape in an instant!

### Business Development Professionals

We help Business Development teams identify startups and new entrants with disruptive technologies,
and track the activities of industry leaders, academic research institutions, and domain experts.
Equipped with these insights, BD teams can make informed decisions about which companies to
collaborate with.

analyze and make sense of market trends, disruptive technology, the competitive landscape, and more.

and stability.

# your partner in biomaterial innovation

[ let's connect ][72]

### ecogenesis is a biomaterial engineering and sustainable product development studio.

Led by a team of tested material scientists and engineers, ecogenesis combines decades of experience
in material science with a relentless commitment to innovation, transparency, and environmental
responsibility to help catalyze the bioeconomy. Join us on our journey to rethink plastic and create
a cleaner, healthier planet.

#### ecogenesis is a biomaterial engineering and sustainable product development studio.

Led by a team of tested material scientists and engineers, ecogenesis combines decades of experience
in material science with a relentless commitment to innovation, transparency, and environmental
responsibility to help catalyze the bioeconomy. Join us on our journey to rethink plastic and create
a cleaner, healthier planet.

ecogenesis biopolymers is your partner in creating bio-based & biodegradable products and packaging.

We are **not** producers of PHA raw materials.  Rather we evaluate and source PHAs from various
qualified suppliers for our custom formulations. 

Given the wide array of methods that PHA can be produced, it does lead to product attribute
variations among suppliers.  Even within the same product category, i.e, a common semi-crystalline
PHA from brand A can have very different attributes from brand B. This does not mean that one
material is better than another, simply that there are nuances in the rheological properties that
maybe better suited for one type of applications vs. the other brand.    

At ecogenesis, we continuously evaluate the growing list of suppliers and material offerings to
ensure we provide solutions that are consistent, free of contaminants, certified, and have the
end-use attributes required.  

With the end-use application in mind, we then formulate to support your operations and production. 
Careful consideration must be taken on material selection to ensure that the customer expectations
regarding the product EOL and performance are met at the lowest possible cost.

### Commercialization Experts

PHA adoption is on the rise, but the industry is still learning how to utilize this material.
Commercial expertise can be hard to find. 

We are fortunate to have over 35 years’ experience in commercializing traditional and bio plastics
utilizing Injection Mold, Blow Mold and Extrusion Mold applications. We have extensive
commercialization experience and will help commercialize your product, including on-site trial
execution, mold and equipment recommendations, QC review, etc. We can fully support your efforts
with on-hand and on-site solutions.

Specifically utilizing PHA, a few of the items we’ve commercialized are a 38mm beverage cap, line of
beverage straws, 3D filament, shampoo cap, and shotgun wad.

Led by a team of tested material scientists and engineers, ecogenesis combines decades of experience

#### ecogenesis is a biomaterial engineering and sustainable product development studio.

Led by a team of tested material scientists and engineers, ecogenesis combines decades of experience
in material science with a relentless commitment to innovation, transparency, and environmental
responsibility to help catalyze the bioeconomy. Join us on our journey to rethink plastic and create
a cleaner, healthier planet.

ecogenesis biopolymers is your partner in creating bio-based & biodegradable products and packaging.

We are **not** producers of PHA raw materials.  Rather we evaluate and source PHAs from various
qualified suppliers for our custom formulations. 

Given the wide array of methods that PHA can be produced, it does lead to product attribute
variations among suppliers.  Even within the same product category, i.e, a common semi-crystalline
PHA from brand A can have very different attributes from brand B. This does not mean that one
material is better than another, simply that there are nuances in the rheological properties that
maybe better suited for one type of applications vs. the other brand.    

At ecogenesis, we continuously evaluate the growing list of suppliers and material offerings to
ensure we provide solutions that are consistent, free of contaminants, certified, and have the
end-use attributes required.  

With the end-use application in mind, we then formulate to support your operations and production. 
Careful consideration must be taken on material selection to ensure that the customer expectations
regarding the product EOL and performance are met at the lowest possible cost.

### Commercialization Experts

PHA adoption is on the rise, but the industry is still learning how to utilize this material.
Commercial expertise can be hard to find. 

We are fortunate to have over 35 years’ experience in commercializing traditional and bio plastics
utilizing Injection Mold, Blow Mold and Extrusion Mold applications. We have extensive
commercialization experience and will help commercialize your product, including on-site trial
execution, mold and equipment recommendations, QC review, etc. We can fully support your efforts
with on-hand and on-site solutions.

Specifically utilizing PHA, a few of the items we’ve commercialized are a 38mm beverage cap, line of
beverage straws, 3D filament, shampoo cap, and shotgun wad.

* ### Improve business performance

  ##### by developing new polymer technology and product platforms, not just single products.

  ##### by developing new/ improved polymer products faster and with nearly zero defects.

  ##### by adapting your existing polymer products or technologies for new markets or applications.
* ### Develop products that are environmentally friendly
  
  ##### by incorporating biopolymers and bioplastics in your products or formulations thereby

  ##### using our proven IP management process and strategy, tailored specifically for polymer

* ### Provide expert witness testimony, litigation support and consulting

#### Our proven polymer consultants work with you to turn obstacles into opportunities

Our polymer consultants provide a wide range of consulting services to growth oriented companies
that use polymers to gain a competitive advantage. We have a skilled team of polymer consultants
with specialties in high performance polymers that are used in formulated products such as
adhesives, composites,laminates, prepregs, encapsulants, coatings, filled polymers, and high
performance thermoplastics.

InnoCentrix has experienced biopolymers and bioplastics consultants, enabling clients to develop
bio-based polymers to their product portfolios. Our polymer consultants have extensive technical and
management experience leading new product development, new business development, and adding
profitable new revenue streams for new or existing products.

[Contact us][15] if you have a complex polymer problem to solve, a new polymer product to develop,
want to explore new market opportunities for your existing polymer technology, or need expert
witness services. Our skilled polymer consultants are ready to enable you to grow your business.

I’m Jeff Gotro and I have a passion for polymers. At InnoCentrix we focus exclusively on polymers.
Our ideal client is a growth-oriented company who wants to increase revenues and profits by
leveraging their polymer technologies. We provide a wide range of services to enable our clients to
grow rapidly. Welcome to InnoCentrix, how can we help you grow your polymer business?

## ABOUT NEXAL

Your Trusted Partner in Chemical Solutions
 
Nexal Inc. is a U.S.-based chemical distribution company dedicated to serving the American market
with high-quality intermediates, food additives, and specialty chemicals. With a strong focus on
import/export and distribution, we bridge global suppliers with local demand across industries
including:
 Pharmaceuticals
 Agrochemicals
 Coatings & Adhesives
 Food & Nutrition

##### 50 años de experiencia en producción de fibra y polímeros

# PASIÓN POR INNOVAR

### [FIBRAS SINTÉTICAS][47]

NUREL Synthetic Fibers lidera la innovación en nylon, ofreciendo una gran gama de productos en Nylon
6 y 66

### [POLÍMEROS][48]

**PROMYDE®** (PA6, PA66 y copoliamidas), **PROXYLENE®** (compounds de PBT y PET), **OLEXENE®**
(compounds de polipropileno), **RECOLINE®** (polímeros reciclados) y **ENOXITE®** (polímeros con
propiedades barrera, permeabilidad controlada y solubilidad en agua)

#### [BIOPOLÍMEROS][49]

NUREL Biopolymers proporciona soluciones biobasadas, compostables y biodegradables para extrusión e
inyección

[ [icono_injection_solutions_Mesa-de-trabajo-1] ][50]

#### [SOLUCIONES DE INYECCIÓN][51]

NUREL Injection Solutions se especializa en el moldeo por inyección de biopolímeros, ofreciendo un
servicio integral desde el diseño hasta la certificación

## Contáctanos

### Descubre nuestros productos

Desde su fundación en **1968** como** Fibras ESSO**, tras la adquisición por parte del **Grupo
SAMCA** en **1999** y hasta el día de hoy, en **NUREL** hemos pasado por diferentes etapas y hemos
conseguido adaptarnos a los rápidos cambios que ha experimentado nuestro entorno social, económico e
industrial.  

[ CONTACTAR ][52]

## nueva división INJECTION SOLUTIONS

Creado para ser sostenible, personalizado para ti

El taco de cartucho biodegradable NOVIZON es un producto innovador diseñado para los entusiastas del
tiro con conciencia medioambiental.

Estos cartuchos están fabricados con biopolímeros que se descomponen en el suelo, de acuerdo con la
norma EN 17556 de biodegradabilidad. Esta norma garantiza que los cartuchos se biodegraden de forma
natural en el suelo sin dejar residuos nocivos, lo que reduce su impacto medioambiental.

[ Descubre NUREL Injection Solutions ][53]

## NUEVA GAMA ENOXITE

BARRERA, SOLUBLE Y AHUMADOS

La línea ENOXITE ofrece soluciones avanzadas en polímeros funcionales para packaging y aplicaciones
alimentarias. Descubre nuestras 3 gamas:
* [**ENOXITE BARRIER**][54], para una protección superior frente a gases y humedad.
* [**ENOXITE WATER**][55], polímeros solubles en agua para formatos monodosis y biodegradables.
* [**ENOXITE SMOKE**][56], diseñados para tripas de alimentos ahumados con alta barrera y excelente
  procesabilidad.

Desarrollados para mejorar la conservación, la sostenibilidad y el rendimiento técnico, los
polímeros ENOXITE se adaptan a las necesidades actuales de la industria.

[ DESCUBRIR ENOXITE ][57]

## nueva división INJECTION SOLUTIONS

Creado para ser sostenible, personalizado para ti

El taco de cartucho biodegradable NOVIZON es un producto innovador diseñado para los entusiastas del
tiro con conciencia medioambiental.

Estos cartuchos están fabricados con biopolímeros que se descomponen en el suelo, de acuerdo con la
norma EN 17556 de biodegradabilidad. Esta norma garantiza que los cartuchos se biodegraden de forma
natural en el suelo sin dejar residuos nocivos, lo que reduce su impacto medioambiental.

[ Descubre NUREL Injection Solutions ][53]

## NUEVA GAMA ENOXITE

BARRERA, SOLUBLE Y AHUMADOS

La línea ENOXITE ofrece soluciones avanzadas en polímeros funcionales para packaging y aplicaciones
alimentarias. Descubre nuestras 3 gamas:
* [**ENOXITE BARRIER**][54], para una protección superior frente a gases y humedad.
* [**ENOXITE WATER**][55], polímeros solubles en agua para formatos monodosis y biodegradables.
* [**ENOXITE SMOKE**][56], diseñados para tripas de alimentos ahumados con alta barrera y excelente
  procesabilidad.

Desarrollados para mejorar la conservación, la sostenibilidad y el rendimiento técnico, los
polímeros ENOXITE se adaptan a las necesidades actuales de la industria.

## Redefining Plastics with PHA

PHA (Polyhydroxyalkanoate) is a 100% bio-based, naturally derived polymer offering a sustainable
alternative to conventional plastics. Fully biodegradable across various environments, PHA supports
a circular economy by minimizing waste and promoting eco-friendly material breakdown.

[Naturally Occurring][Naturally Occurring]

### Naturally Occurring

PHA is created from natural processes, making it a sustainable and eco-friendly material.

[100% Biobased][100% Biobased]

### 100% Biobased

Sourced entirely from renewable, plant-based feedstocks, PHA is free from fossil fuels.

[Fully Biodegradable][Fully Biodegradable]

### Fully Biodegradable

PHA naturally decomposes in various environments, leaving no harmful residues behind.

## Redefining Plastics with PHA

PHA (Polyhydroxyalkanoate) is a 100% bio-based, naturally derived polymer offering a sustainable
alternative to conventional plastics. Fully biodegradable across various environments, PHA supports
a circular economy by minimizing waste and promoting eco-friendly material breakdown.

[Naturally Occurring][Naturally Occurring]

### Naturally Occurring

PHA is created from natural processes, making it a sustainable and eco-friendly material.

[100% Biobased][100% Biobased]

### 100% Biobased

Sourced entirely from renewable, plant-based feedstocks, PHA is free from fossil fuels.

[Fully Biodegradable][Fully Biodegradable]

### Fully Biodegradable

PHA naturally decomposes in various environments, leaving no harmful residues behind.

# About BIOPOLYMERS-2026


We are delighted to announce the **2nd International Conference on Biopolymers and Polymer Science
(BIOPOLYMERS-2026)**, which will be held from **October 19-20, 2026** in the beautiful city of
**Venice, Italy**. This premier two-day event will gather leading scientists, researchers, and
industry professionals from around the world to share their latest findings, exchange innovative
ideas and foster new collaborations in the fields of biopolymers and polymer science.

**BIOPOLYMERS-2026** will focus on recent advancements and address emerging challenges in areas such
as **polymers, biopolymers, sustainable materials, fibers, textiles, and nanocomposites**. The
conference will feature **plenary and keynote lectures** delivered by distinguished experts,
providing valuable insights into cutting-edge research and technological developments. Participants
will also have the opportunity to showcase their work through **oral and poster presentations**,
promoting academic discussion and professional growth.

In addition to presentations, the event will host **interactive workshops and exhibitions**, giving
attendees hands-on experiences and exposure to the latest products and technologies in the field.
This conference provides an exceptional platform for networking, allowing participants to connect
with peers, engage with global experts, and explore collaborative opportunities for research and
innovation.

We warmly invite you to join us in Venice for **BIOPOLYMERS-2026**, an intellectually enriching
event that promises to be both inspiring and memorable.


Sincerely,
P. Ramya | Conference Secretary

#### Biography

Stephane Bruzaud is Full Professor at the University of South Brittany (UBS) located in Lorient
(France). He was graduated as MSc from Chemistry Department at University of Bordeaux. He received
his Ph.D. degree in 1995 from the same university. His current research focuses on the development
of biobased and/or biodegradable polymers, from their production to their end of life. He leads a
research group specializing in biopolymer engineering. This involves implementing virtuous
approaches for the elaboration (through biotechnological processes using classical biobased carbon
substrates or wastes derived from agroindustrial by-products, for example) and the formulation
(blending with other biopolymers and/or incorporation of natural fillers) of bioplastics, as well as
studying their (bio)degradation. StÃ©phane Bruzaud is involved in numerous academic and industrial
collaborations, with contracts funded by Europe, ANR, the French Minister of Environment, CNRS,
ADEME, Brittany region, TASSILI and industrial partners. He has supervised 22 Ph.D. students and
authored over 120 papers in peer reviewed journals and 07 book chapters.

Institute national polytechnique de Lorraine as part of an ANRT CIFRE grant with AcelorMittal on the
development and characterization of metal/polymer composites for the automotive sector. In 2011, he
was appointed Associate Professor at the Ecole Nationale Superieure des Mines de Nancy, University
of Lorraine. He heads the "Biomaterials Engineering" program within the Materials Science and
Engineering Department at the Ecole des Mines de Nancy. In 2019, he obtained his accreditation to
supervise research (HDR). He conducts his research activities at the Jean Lamour Institute within
the "Physics, Mechanics and Plasticity of Polymers and Composites" team, which he heads, as part of
the study of the relationships between processing, microstructure and properties.

# About BIOPOLYMERS-2026


We are delighted to announce the **2nd International Conference on Biopolymers and Polymer Science
(BIOPOLYMERS-2026)**, which will be held from **October 19-20, 2026** in the beautiful city of
**Venice, Italy**. This premier two-day event will gather leading scientists, researchers, and
industry professionals from around the world to share their latest findings, exchange innovative
ideas and foster new collaborations in the fields of biopolymers and polymer science.

**BIOPOLYMERS-2026** will focus on recent advancements and address emerging challenges in areas such
as **polymers, biopolymers, sustainable materials, fibers, textiles, and nanocomposites**. The
conference will feature **plenary and keynote lectures** delivered by distinguished experts,
providing valuable insights into cutting-edge research and technological developments. Participants
will also have the opportunity to showcase their work through **oral and poster presentations**,
promoting academic discussion and professional growth.

attendees hands-on experiences and exposure to the latest products and technologies in the field.

with peers, engage with global experts, and explore collaborative opportunities for research and
innovation.

event that promises to be both inspiring and memorable.

#### Biography

Dr. Sharina Perry is a visionary entrepreneur and inventor with over 25 years of experience building
and leading national businesses. She is the founder and inventor of Utopia Plastix, a plant-based
alternative to petroleum-based polymers, and the creator of The Utopia Model, a sustainable
ecosystem business framework. Recognized globally as an innovator and strategist, Sharina has earned
numerous leadership and sustainability certifications, including from the University of Oklahoma and
Cambridge Judge Business School, and holds multiple global patents and trademarks. She serves in
several leadership roles, including on the Oklahoma Governors Minority Business Council, the
Oklahoma District Export Council and as Chair of the Advisory Board for the University of Oklahoma's
Multicultural Business Program. Sharina has been widely celebrated for her contributions to
sustainability, innovation and minority business advancement earning honors such as 2025 Oklahoman
of the Year, Global Visionary Award and inclusion among Forbes Top 10 Women to Watch (2023). A TEDx
speaker, international keynote presenter and bestselling author, Sharina Perry continues to inspire
global progress in sustainability, leadership and equitable innovation.

#### Biography

Prof. Hanshen Li received his B.S.E. degree in Electric Power Engineering and Automation from
Shanghai Jiao Tong University (SJTU), Shanghai, China, in 2016. He earned his M.E. degree in
Information, Production, and Systems Engineering from Waseda University, Tokyo, Japan, in 2017, and
another M.E. degree in Electrical Engineering from SJTU in 2019. He completed his Ph.D. in
Electrical Engineering at North China Electric Power University (NCEPU), Beijing, China, in 2023.
Since 2023, Prof. Li has been a researcher at the China Electric Power Planning and Engineering
Institute (EPPEI). His research interests include the planning and operation of active distribution
networks. Prof. Li has published over 50 papers with more than 200 citations. He has been a member
of the editorial board of the Journal of Energy Science and Technology since 2023, and is also a
member of IEEE, IEEJ, CSEE, and CES.

## Renewable Carbon by nova-Institute

Welcome to www.renewable-carbon.eu, the website showcasing nova-Institute’s many services around
renewable carbon: the bio- and CO2-based economy as well as chemical recycling. nova-Institute is a
science-based research and consultancy company. Organiser of leading expert conferences, workshops
and webinars.

[Subscribe]

### Renewable Carbon Newsletters

Stay informed about the latest developments in the renewable carbon industry and nova-Institute’s
activities. Choose the news relevant to your business out of 19 different topics: sustainability –
renewable carbon – recycling – policy – pharma – natural fibres – food – engineering – energy –
digital and artificial intelligence – carbon, capture and utilization – bio-based materials –
plastics and composites – bio-based chemicals and industrial biotechnology – automotive –
agriculture, forestry and resources – nova’s monthly newsletter – Renewable Carbon Newsletter –
Press releases – events and conferences.

[**https://renewable-carbon.eu/newsletters**][38]

The leading business directory for the bio-based, CO2-based and recycled materials gives you the
opportunity to look up suppliers, partners and service providers or present your own company and
products to the right audience for you.

[https://renewable-carbon.eu/companies/][39]

[nova-Institute]

### nova-Institute

nova-Institut GmbH has been working in the field of sustainability since the mid-1990s and today
focuses primarily on the areas of circular economy, bioeconomy and CO2 utilisation. 

The independent company supports the chemical and plastics industries in the transition from fossil
to renewable carbon – based on biomass, CO2 utilisation or recycling – through research and
science-based consulting. 

Both in accompanying research for innovation projects and in individual business consulting, nova’s
interdisciplinary team covers the entire value chain. It works on all topics from raw materials,
technology scouting and market research to economics, policy, life cycle assessments and
sustainability, as well as support in communication and strategy development.
50 experts from different fields work together to defossilise the industry and create a
climate-neutral future.

[**www.nova-institute.eu**][40]

[21 01 07 RC Diamanten Menu Renewable Carbon]

### Renewable Carbon

What is renewable carbon?

Renewable Carbon entails all carbon sources that avoid or substitute the use of any additional
fossil carbon from the geosphere. Renewable carbon can come from the biosphere, atmosphere or
technosphere – but not from the geosphere. Renewable carbon circulates between biosphere, atmosphere
or technosphere, creating a carbon circular economy.

How does it differ from the bioeconomy and circular economy? This page provides a definition and
background on the renewable carbon strategy and why it is relevant to you.

[**www.renewable-carbon.eu/info**][41]

[21 01 07 RC Diamanten Menu Events]

### Renewable Carbon Events

nova-Institute hosts workshops and conferences, big and small, for an expert audience. Some related
to our research projects, some as stand-alone events. Most notable the Renewable Materials
Conference ([www.renewable-materials.eu][42]), International Conference on Cellulose Fibres
([www.cellulose-fibres.eu][43]), Conference on CO2-based Fuels and Chemicals
([www.co2-chemistry.eu][44]) and the nova Sessions, a series of workshops on pressing political
issues and market developments. On this website, you can find all upcoming events.

[**www.renewable-carbon.eu/events**][45]

[nova-Institute]

### nova-Institute

nova-Institut GmbH has been working in the field of sustainability since the mid-1990s and today
focuses primarily on the areas of circular economy, bioeconomy and CO2 utilisation. 

The independent company supports the chemical and plastics industries in the transition from fossil
to renewable carbon – based on biomass, CO2 utilisation or recycling – through research and
science-based consulting. 

Both in accompanying research for innovation projects and in individual business consulting, nova’s
interdisciplinary team covers the entire value chain. It works on all topics from raw materials,
technology scouting and market research to economics, policy, life cycle assessments and
sustainability, as well as support in communication and strategy development.
50 experts from different fields work together to defossilise the industry and create a
climate-neutral future.

[**www.nova-institute.eu**][40]

[21 01 07 RC Diamanten Menu Renewable Carbon]

### Renewable Carbon

What is renewable carbon?

Renewable Carbon entails all carbon sources that avoid or substitute the use of any additional
fossil carbon from the geosphere. Renewable carbon can come from the biosphere, atmosphere or
technosphere – but not from the geosphere. Renewable carbon circulates between biosphere, atmosphere
or technosphere, creating a carbon circular economy.

How does it differ from the bioeconomy and circular economy? This page provides a definition and
background on the renewable carbon strategy and why it is relevant to you.

[**www.renewable-carbon.eu/info**][41]

# ABOUT SABIC

From making cars and planes more fuel-efficient, to helping conserve the world’s water supply and
enabling colorful smartphone cases, we find solutions to the challenges of today to help our
customers achieve their ambitions and build a better tomorrow.

## PBAT

Description


The PBAT, polybutylene adipate terephthalate, is a compostable and biodegradable polymer used mainly
in the film process.

 

One of the most interesting characteristics of this material is the possibility to optain it from
both organic and fossil sources. Therefore, the supply of industrial quantities is always guaranteed
according to market needs.

It has the following certificates: Vincotte, Ok compost and BPI and FDA.









Some of the most important features and properties of the PBAT are:

* Good binding properties;

 
* Good insulator;

 
* High flexibility and resistance;

 
* It can be customized;

 
* It complies with UNI EN 13432: 2002 (relating to packaging) and UNI EN 14995: 2006.

## PBAT

Description


The PBAT, polybutylene adipate terephthalate, is a compostable and biodegradable polymer used mainly
in the film process.

 

One of the most interesting characteristics of this material is the possibility to optain it from
both organic and fossil sources. Therefore, the supply of industrial quantities is always guaranteed
according to market needs.

It has the following certificates: Vincotte, Ok compost and BPI and FDA.









Some of the most important features and properties of the PBAT are:

* Good binding properties;

 
* Good insulator;

 
* High flexibility and resistance;

 
* It can be customized;

 
* It complies with UNI EN 13432: 2002 (relating to packaging) and UNI EN 14995: 2006.

  for a wide range of applications, including the most complex. Early market insights and broad

  Trelleborg serve industries where performance, reliability and sustainability are critical; these
  include aerospace, automotive, medical, energy & renewables, water infrastructure, semiconductor
  manufacturing, food & beverage, and others.
  
  Our solutions protect the essential: people, industrial equipment, infrastructure and the
  environment.

  multiple parameters with highly selective approach, targeting attractive niches and developing
  globally leading positions.

leadership and accountability. We believe every employee has the potential to make a meaningful
impact and shape industry from the inside.

## FAQ
* What does Trelleborg specialize in?
  Trelleborg Group specialize in engineered polymer solutions. We offer a unique solutions portfolio
  for a wide range of applications, including the most complex. Early market insights and broad
  expertise make us a world leader in engineered polymer solutions.
* Which industries does Trelleborg serve?
  Trelleborg serve industries where performance, reliability and sustainability are critical; these
  include aerospace, automotive, medical, energy & renewables, water infrastructure, semiconductor
  manufacturing, food & beverage, and others.
  
  Our solutions protect the essential: people, industrial equipment, infrastructure and the
  environment.
  [Your Industry][32]
* What is Trelleborg’s strategic focus?
  Trelleborg focus on leading positions in selected segments. We make an overall assessment based on
  multiple parameters with highly selective approach, targeting attractive niches and developing
  globally leading positions.
  
* Where does Trelleborg operate?
  Trelleborg operate globally through state-of-the-art manufacturing facilities, R&D centers, sales
  offices, and distribution networks. We strive to maintain a strong physical presence close to our
  customers.
